title: Cover
description: PawHub — India's 10-minute pet care app. Bangalore · 2026.

title: The Problem
description: Indian pet parents are stuck in WhatsApp groups — no reliability, transparency, SLA, or trusted brand.

title: The Solution
description: Book any pet service in 10 minutes — one app, vetted providers, transparent pricing.

title: Why Now
description: Three tailwinds converging: pet boom, premium pet parents, 10-minute expectations.

title: Product
description: One app, every pet need — booking flow, provider profile, and pet profile + ETA.

title: Business Model
description: 15–20% take-rate on every booking. Path to ₹100Cr ARR by Year 3.

title: Projected Numbers
description: 3-year financial trajectory across cities, bookings, GMV, and revenue.

title: Traction
description: 400 waitlist users, willingness-to-pay data, validation landing page live.

title: Moat
description: Zepto for pet services — dense provider network, quick-commerce ops, supply lock-in.

title: Team
description: Backed by a 400-person team — incubated inside Replit, led by Syed Adil.

title: The Ask
description: Raising $1B to build the densest provider network, hit 10K bookings/month, and expand to 4 metros.
